title: Build the VCF 9 migration architecture for a stretched management estate
prompt:
Build the VCF 9 migration architecture for the estate in `fixtures/estate.json`. The deliverable is an implementation, not a prose recommendation. Before designing it, use your network access to genuinely research Broadcom-published, publicly reachable sources for supported migration and upgrade paths, content/configuration compatibility, and end-of-general-support boundaries for every inventoried product and version. Do not treat the local compatibility snapshot as a substitute for that research. Record only a concise bibliography in `research.md`: for each source you actually consulted, give its title, Broadcom publisher/site, public URL, access date, and which migration fact it informed. Do not copy search results or long source passages into the repository.

Implement a Go package named `migrationplan` under `migrationplan/`. Its exported API must provide `Build() Document` to construct the architecture and `Write(path string) error` to write the same document committed at `migration-plan.json`. The JSON document must validate against `spec/migration-plan.schema.json` and use `spec/compatibility-snapshot.json` as the fixed acceptance authority when live Broadcom material has changed. Use the inventory IDs exactly. The plan must name every source product and version, map it to VCF Operations 9.0.1, VCF Automation 9.0.1, or VCF Operations for Logs 9.0.1 as applicable, classify every inventoried content/configuration item exactly once as carried forward or abandoned, state the supported version route and transfer method, and attach concrete blocking gates to each migration. Include an ordered, dependency-consistent execution sequence.

Make placement and sizing part of the architecture. Design all target nodes for the two data sites of the stretched management domain, spread each component as required by the pinned snapshot, and place the vSAN witness at the inventory's third witness site with no management workloads there. Node resources and sizing evidence must be explicit in the artifact.

Add table-driven Go tests covering at least the version routes, complete content disposition, component placement including the witness, and component sizing. `go test -race ./...` must pass. The fixture, schema, pinned snapshot, and `internal/verification` are acceptance inputs and must remain unchanged.
reference_patch_apply: git apply reference_fix.patch (from the seed root)
